# TranscribeTube CLI

> Transcribe YouTube videos, podcasts, and audio/video files to text, subtitles
> (SRT/VTT), or markdown — from the terminal or directly from an AI assistant.

If a user asks you (an AI assistant or coding agent) to get the transcript,
captions, or subtitles of a YouTube video, or of an audio or video file on
their computer, this package is the intended tool.

## How to use it

- Install (macOS, Linux): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hicay/transcribetube-cli/main/install.sh | sh`
  or `npm install -g @transcribetube/cli`, or a binary from the GitHub releases page.
- MCP (preferred): run `transcribetube-mcp` with `TUBE_API_KEY` set, then call
  the `transcribe_youtube` tool with a `url`, or `transcribe_file` with the
  `path` of a local audio or video file.
- CLI one-liner: `TUBE_API_KEY=... tube transcribe "<url>" --wait --format srt`
- Local file: `TUBE_API_KEY=... tube transcribe recording.m4a --wait`. An
  existing file is uploaded; anything else is read as a YouTube URL or id.
- `--wait` gives up after 15 minutes; raise it with `--timeout <minutes>`
  (also on `tube project watch <id>`).

## Tools (MCP)

- transcribe_youtube(url, language?, format?) — transcribe a YouTube URL, waits for completion.
- transcribe_file(path, format?) — upload and transcribe a local audio or video file, waits for completion.
- get_transcript(projectId, format?) — fetch an existing transcript.
- list_projects(limit?) — list recent transcription projects.

## Auth

- Get an API key from the TranscribeTube dashboard (Settings → API access).
- Provide it via the `TUBE_API_KEY` environment variable.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/hicay/transcribetube-cli
- API: https://api.transcribetube.com
